import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Convert text-encoded numbers to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (should be positive)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Fix body_mass_g out-of-range values (e.g., 5700000 -> 5700)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    # Normalize sex labels to lowercase
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
